item.title: Clearer game changes in chat
item.summary: Murph now says when a new game request replaces your partner's, and asks only about what was just requested.
item.details: When Murph can't make a change, it explains the rule and suggests the closest option. A day with no post is still open until 3 AM. You can call off a game in chat before it starts; once it's live, Murph explains what you can still change.
